idea.idea: Using Canva's new 2-stage planning AI model to design retail promotion banners
idea.angle: Stop paying freelance designers ₹500 per poster: Canva Craft plans visual layout hierarchy before generating, preventing cluttered graphics.
idea.audience_problem: Small shop owners and retailers spend too much money or time struggling to design legible sale graphics for WhatsApp status and print.

hooks: Design posters in 2 steps without paying freelance designers
Why your AI-generated shop flyers look messy and cluttered
Stop wasting money on designers for basic WhatsApp ads
piece.hook_reason: It addresses the specific pain point (cost) and the solution (the 2-stage process) directly, which appeals to small business owners looking for immediate practical value.

slides.title: AI Design Myth
slides.subtitle: Why most AI posters look wrong.
slides.body: AI image tools often struggle with text and layout. Canva Craft changes this by planning the design before it draws the image.
slides.myth: AI image generators are just for pretty pictures.
slides.fact: Canva Craft plans spatial relationships, scale, and visual hierarchy first, ensuring your text is actually legible.

piece.caption: Stop paying ₹500 for simple WhatsApp posters. Canva's new Craft model is designed specifically for business layouts, meaning it thinks about where your text goes before it creates the graphic. This solves the classic 'cluttered AI' problem where words end up looking like gibberish. If you run a hardware shop or a small office, you can now iterate on promo banners in minutes instead of waiting for a freelancer. Remember, technology doesn't replace your judgment—you still need to ensure the final output is relevant to your customers. Start by testing a simple festival sale banner in Dream Lab today. What is the biggest hurdle you face when creating your own shop marketing materials?

issues: The term '2 steps' in the hook and slide 1 is slightly misleading as the process involves more than two distinct actions (opening, menu, tab, prompt).
The caption mentions '₹500' which is a good local touch, but ensure the tone remains professional and not overly dismissive of freelancers.
review.fix_instructions: The content is strong and ready for publication. To improve, change '2 steps' to 'simple steps' in the hook and slide 1 to avoid being technically inaccurate. The visual design is clean and adheres to the brand guidelines. Ensure the final export is high resolution for Instagram's carousel format.
